name: pimctl
title_zh: Azure 资源角色没激活？先查再开再关的那条命令
tagline_zh: 授权报错时最烦的是分不清「没权限」还是「没激活」。它先列出你有资格的角色和当前激活状态，再按预设一键开、到点关。
tagline_en: When auth fails, is it missing permission or missing activation? List eligible roles, see what's live, then.
desc_en: Use the pimctl CLI to list eligible Azure resource roles, inspect active PIM access, activate or deactivate roles, and use saved presets. Use for Azure resource PIM tasks or to investigate whether missing PIM activation explains an authorization failure. Does not cover Entra ID directory roles, PIM for Groups, or development of the pimctl repository.
why_zh: 把「查资格—看现状—开—关」收进一个 CLI，还能存预设，排查授权失败时不用在门户里来回点。
why_en: Eligibility, current state, activate, deactivate, and saved presets in one CLI — no portal clicking while debugging an authz.
limit_zh: 只管 Azure 资源的 PIM 角色：Entra ID 目录角色和 PIM for Groups 都不覆盖。
limit_en: Azure resource roles only — no Entra ID directory roles, no PIM for Groups, no pimctl repo development. Requires pimctl installed and an Azure login.
title_en: Check, activate, and deactivate Azure PIM roles from one CLI
